description: This file contains implementation of MPSEvent and MPSEventPool classes used for event management and synchronization in Apple's Metal Performance Shaders (MPS) framework within PyTorch's ATen library. It defines methods for recording, waiting, notifying, querying, and timing GPU events, as well as managing a pool of such events.

classes.name: MPSEvent
classes.description: Represents a GPU event for recording, synchronization, and performance timing in Metal.

classes.name: MPSEventPool
classes.description: Manages a pool of MPSEvent objects for efficient reuse and lifetime management.

methods.name: recordLocked
methods.description: Records a GPU event with optional timing and synchronization.

methods.name: waitLocked
methods.description: Waits for a GPU event to complete with optional synchronization.

methods.name: notifyLocked
methods.description: Sets up a notification callback for when the GPU event reaches a certain signal value.

methods.name: record
methods.description: Schedules recording of the event with optional locking and synchronization.

methods.name: wait
methods.description: Schedules waiting on the event with optional locking and synchronization.

methods.name: notify
methods.description: Schedules a notification callback on the event with optional locking.

methods.name: synchronize
methods.description: Ensures GPU completion and captures timing.

methods.name: query
methods.description: Checks if the event has been signaled.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the event to initial state for reuse.

methods.name: acquireEvent
methods.description: Retrieves an event from the pool or creates a new one.

methods.name: releaseEvent
methods.description: Releases an event back to the pool.

methods.name: recordEvent
methods.description: Records an event with optional synchronization.

methods.name: waitForEvent
methods.description: Waits for a specific event to complete.

methods.name: queryEvent
methods.description: Queries the status of a specific event.

methods.name: elapsedTime
methods.description: Calculates elapsed time between two events.
